name: F&N
recent: F&N 近期完成出售 Vacaron 50% 股权，最终代价约 RM181.55 million；同时 EPF 在 9 月至 11 月间多次申报持股变动。公司于 11 月 5 日发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度的业绩，并有两项其他公告。
notable: 完成出售 Vacaron 50% 股权予 Tan & Tan Developments，最终代价确定为 RM181,550,800。
2026 年 9 月 3 日收到首期款项 RM136,207,789.50，占临时代价的 75%。
EPF 于 9 月至 11 月期间多次申报持股变动。
risks: EPF 在 9 月至 11 月间频繁申报持股变动，显示大股东持股持续调整。

recent_en: F&N recently completed the disposal of its 50% stake in Vacaron for a final consideration of approximately RM181.55 million; EPF also filed multiple changes in shareholding between September and November. The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 5 November, along with two other announcements.
notable_en: Completed the disposal of its 50% stake in Vacaron to Tan & Tan Developments, with the final consideration fixed at RM181,550,800.
Received the first tranche payment of RM136,207,789.50, representing 75% of the interim consideration, on 3 September 2026.
EPF filed multiple changes in shareholding between September and November.
risks_en: EPF's frequent shareholding change filings between September and November indicate ongoing adjustments by a substantial shareholder.
